title: Martin, But He Gains 100 ELO Every Move
summary: 'Smarten': Martin starts at 250 and gains 100 Elo after every move he makes. Player (white) plays fast and aggressive (d5 etc.) to win material before Martin passes ~1000; by the time Martin is ~1750 the player is up a knight and rook and simply trades down, promotes and delivers a ladder mate to win game 1.
rules: After every move Martin makes, his Elo increases by 100 (so on his nth move he plays at 250+100*(n-1)).
win_condition: Checkmate Martin. Video: won game 1 (ladder mate).
